build_load_tokenizer: load a pretrained tokenizer from a Hugging Face model name or local directory path
create_encode_text: encode text strings or pre-tokenized word lists into token IDs with padding and truncation options
apply_chat_template: apply a Jinja chat template to a conversation list and tokenize the result into input IDs
save_tokenizer_pretrained: save a tokenizer configuration vocabulary and added tokens to a local directory
convert_batch_encoding_tensors: convert BatchEncoding dictionary values to PyTorch or NumPy tensors with optional batch axis
